description: Dual-DGX-Spark vLLM 0.30.0 TP2+EP+MTP3 profile for NVIDIA's 133 GB Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 checkpoint, following MiaAI-Lab's vLLM 0.30 lane: stock vLLM loads the checkpoint natively, BF16 KV cache by default (FP8 KV is an option, via a baked vllm#55557 backport), a 47k reduced MTP draft vocabulary, MTP block-drop and index-share fixes, breakable CUDA graphs off, bfloat16 GDN state, GPU memory utilization 0.80, and a native 262144-token context (YaRN is added only above it). Optional bundled 65k German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, and Chinese MTP draft vocabularies are available for language-matched traffic; the English/code 47k choice remains the default. Upstream reports language-specific draft-acceptance and decode changes; these have not been measured on Vonk's dual-Spark deployment. Vonk physical acceptance is pending.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks
